contradicting_evidence: BTC's positive settled ETF flow provides some demand support rather than a uniformly adverse flow backdrop.
Positive completed-hour spot buying in both BTC and ETH could develop into stronger stabilization if repeated.
The older mid-alt proxy had about 68% advancers and a positive median return, while the Top-100-tail proxy also had a positive median; selective participation could broaden.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Expect an unresolved stabilization-and-retest pattern rather than confirmed continuation. BTC may remain relatively resilient while ETH and altcoin follow-through stays uneven. Retest risk persists unless spot demand, ETH/BTC and breadth improve together; the present evidence does not support a firm one-way decline either.
falsification_conditions: Sustained price gains with improving ETH/BTC, repeated broader participation and evidence of persistent spot demand would invalidate the mixed path toward upside.
Failure of stabilization alongside persistent spot selling, further ETH-relative weakness and broader declines would invalidate the mixed path toward downside.
missing_evidence: A sequence showing whether near-balanced current breadth broadens or contracts after the hourly rebound.
New settled ETF information beyond the October 29 session, rather than treating unchanged packet values as new flows.
Repeated funding, OI and spot-volume observations establishing whether leverage growth is accompanied by durable demand.
A current dominance trend; the single settled 60.1008% BTC-dominance level cannot establish rotation direction.
supporting_evidence: Positive hourly BTC and ETH returns coexist with declining ETH/BTC and a freshest breadth advance ratio of 49%, supporting uneven stabilization rather than broad recovery.
Settled ETF flows are divergent: modest positive BTC flow contrasts with substantial negative ETH flow.
Stablecoin supply declined over one, seven and 30 days, with deployment confirmation explicitly not established.

Older capitalization buckets show selective mid- and smaller-alt strength, but the large-alt proxy had fewer than half its constituents advancing and a negative median return. This is incomplete transmission, not a confirmed capitalization sequence.
